title: The Field Sheet
standfirst: The figures that move, read on the official sources on 26 October 2026. Where the Book and this Sheet disagree, the Sheet is newer and wins.

rows.label: Leonardo Express to Termini
rows.value: ≈ €14 a person (4 for €40) · 32 min · every 15 min, some hours 30

rows.label: FL1 regional train (Trastevere, Ostiense, Tiburtina; not Termini)
rows.value: ≈ €8 a person (tariff of Oct 2024, still the one published)
rows.source: https://www.trenitalia.com/content/dam/trenitalia/allegati/info/condizioni-generali-di-trasporto/parte-iii-trasporto-regionale/19-TARIFFA_1TER_Fiumicino_Aeroporto.pdf (tariff from 28 Oct 2024; read by Ruth 2026-10-25) — check current: newest tariff found is 2024

rows.label: Onward hop from Termini, two people
rows.value: ≈ €3 by metro (2 × €1.50) · ≈ €9–13 by taxi
rows.source: https://www.atac.roma.it/biglietti-e-abbonamenti/roma24h ; https://www.comune.roma.it/web-resources/cms/documents/TariffarioTaxi_giugno2026.pdf (Delib. G.C. 157, 21 May 2026; read 2026-10-26) (minimum ride €9; 5 km standard €13.10)

rows.label: Train + hop, door to door, two people
Roma Capitale taxi, Fiumicino → the “Aurelian Walls” zone
rows.value: €55 fixed, the whole party up to 4, bags included; + €5 per passenger beyond 4 · the zone is the walled city plus the Vatican, Borgo and Prati up to Viale delle Milizie (set 2024, reissued May 2026)
rows.source: https://www.comune.roma.it/web-resources/cms/documents/TariffarioTaxi_giugno2026.pdf (Delib. G.C. 157, 21 May 2026; perimeter "MURA AURELIANE … clockwise boundary" incl. "Via Cipro … Piazzale degli Eroi, Via Andrea Doria, Largo Trionfale, Viale delle Milizie … Ponte Matteotti"; read 2026-10-26); https://www.adr.it/web/aeroporti-di-roma-en/pax-fco-taxi (read 2026-10-26)

rows.label: Taxi beyond that zone (e.g. north of Viale delle Milizie)
rows.value: meter: at least €35, at most €80
rows.source: https://www.comune.roma.it/web-resources/cms/documents/TariffarioTaxi_giugno2026.pdf (Delib. G.C. 157, 21 May 2026; perimeter "MURA AURELIANE … clockwise boundary" incl. "Via Cipro … Piazzale degli Eroi, Via Andrea Doria, Largo Trionfale, Viale delle Milizie … Ponte Matteotti"; read 2026-10-26)

rows.label: How to spot an official taxi
rows.value: white · TAXI on the roof · emblem and license number on the front doors · the €55 is Roma Capitale’s, so look for Rome’s emblem; Fiumicino town taxis charge their own town’s fares: check current (no official Fiumicino tariff found)
rows.source: https://www.adr.it/web/aeroporti-di-roma-en/pax-fco-taxi (read 2026-10-26: "Fares are set by the competent municipality"; "Fiumicino municipal taxis are available in the areas indicated in front of Terminal 1 and Terminal 3"); no tariff on comune.fiumicino.rm.it (WebSearch 2026-10-26)

rows.label: Single ride (BIT, 100 min) · Tap & Go cap
rows.value: €1.50 · €8.50 for 24 h from your first tap · each rider taps their own card or phone, the same one every time

rows.label: Fine, unvalidated paper ticket
rows.value: ≈ €105 · ≈ €55 if paid within 5 days

rows.label: Omnia Card (incl. Vatican Museums)
rows.value: 72 h ≈ €149 · 24 h: check current (the official page gives no price)

rows.label: Colosseum 24 h ticket (with Forum + Palatine)
rows.value: on sale 30 days ahead · named; each visitor shows photo ID · price: check current (colosseo.it unreachable 26 Oct)
rows.source: https://colosseo.it/orari-e-biglietti/ (via WebSearch excerpt 2026-10-26: "aperte 30 giorni prima"; "nominativo per tutte le tipologie"; "documento di riconoscimento")

rows.label: Full Experience · Arena · Underground
rows.value: Arena opens ≈ 7 days ahead · Underground 30 days ahead, sells out fast

rows.label: Vatican Museums
rows.value: €20 + €5 to book online · booking window: check current (not stated on the official page)

rows.label: Borghese Gallery
rows.value: booking compulsory for every ticket (+ €2) · price: check current (official site unreachable 26 Oct)
rows.source: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/visita/info-biglietti/ ("PRENOTAZIONE OBBLIGATORIA per tutte le tipologie di biglietto € 2,00"; read by Ruth 2026-10-25)

rows.label: Pantheon
rows.value: ≈ €7 since 1 July 2026 · booking optional; buy at the door or kiosk

rows.label: Free first Sundays (state sites, incl. the Colosseum)
rows.value: 1 Nov · 6 Dec 2026 · 3 Jan 2027 · walk-up, first come

rows.label: Vatican Museums
rows.value: Mon–Sat 8 a.m.–8 p.m., last entry 6 · closed Sundays except the last (free, 9–2; 29 Nov, 27 Dec) · closed 1 Nov, 8, 25, 26 Dec, 1, 6 Jan

rows.label: Ostia Antica · Borghese Gallery
rows.value: both closed Mondays (Ostia also 25 Dec, 1 Jan)
rows.source: https://ostiaantica.cultura.gov.it/ ; https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/visita/ (unreachable 26 Oct; Park wording via WebSearch excerpts 2026-10-26)

rows.label: Colosseum, winter (25 Oct 2026–28 Feb 2027)
rows.value: closes 4:30 p.m., last entry 3:30 · closed 25 Dec, 1 Jan

rows.label: Transport strikes
rows.value: listed ahead on the ministry calendar (mit.gov.it) · Rome buses and metro guaranteed until 8:30 a.m. and 5–8 p.m.
rows.source: https://www.mit.gov.it/ (Calendario scioperi trasporti); https://cotralspa.it/metromare/ ("fino alle 08:30 e dalle 17:00 alle 20:00"; read 2026-10-26)

rows.label: Porta San Paolo → Ostia Antica (Roma–Lido)
rows.value: ≈ 26 min · every 20 min Mon–Sat · timetable from 27 July 2026

rows.label: Rome → Naples, high speed · then to Pompeii
rows.value: a little over 1 h, 100+ trains a day · Circumvesuviana and Pompeii hours: check current (no official page read)

rows.label: At any card reader
rows.value: choose euros, never dollars

rows.label: US passport · border · ETIAS
rows.value: valid 3 months past your Schengen exit (6 recommended), 2 blank pages, up to 90 days in any 180 · fingerprints and photo at the border (EES: began 12 Oct 2025, fully in force since 10 Apr 2026) · ETIAS not yet required: check current, no start date announced

rows.label: Emergency, anywhere in the EU
rows.value: 112, free

note: ◇ official: a regulated fare or published rule. ◆ volatile: a live price, window or timetable, true on the date read. ● established. A ≈ price is the one the official source showed on the date above; "check current" means we could not confirm it on an official page, and says why. Read the Book once; carry this page in the trip week, and check the ◆ rows the week you fly. Every source, with the date it was checked, is on the Sources page at the back of the Book. Reissued quarterly at romeforamericans.com/guide/sheet.
